messages.author: 3b0940ce7a895cd1
messages.subject: Re: Add a 2nd Y axis to a qplot()
parts:
A 2nd Y axis is not yet a feature of ggplot. Hadley did promise that he was going to think about this over Christmas, exactly for the situation
where the same underlying construct was being measured on both the axes... but denominated differently.   I do not think that Hadley intends to write anything that would like some Y variables to one axis and other Y variables to another axis.  


I  suppose, with apologies to Tolkien, the stance could be paraphrased:

One axis  to rule them all,
One axis  to find them,
One axis  to bring them all...


R
